name: 하쓰바
silhouette: 낮게 웅크린 4족 보행 체형, 뒤로 뻗은 굵은 꼬리, 툭 튀어나온 짧은 뿔, 돌진을 위해 앞다리에 집중된 무게감
signature_motion: 몸을 둥글게 웅크렸다가 앞으로 강하게 튕겨 나가는 돌진
signature_vfx: 돌진 시 바닥에 남는 밝은 노란색의 잔상과 작은 불꽃 파편
visual_en: A small, 2-head-tall lizard creature facing right. It has a low-slung, crouching silhouette with thick, dark orange scales. Its eyes are a piercing, bright yellow that stands out in the dark. A short, blunt horn protrudes from its head, and a thick tail with a flickering bright yellow flame at the tip follows behind. Around its neck, a simple red band is visible. The creature's limbs are short and powerful, built for sudden lunges, with bright white sparks appearing on its claws.
pose_en: Crouching low, ready to spring forward with intense focus.
vfx_en: Bright yellow sparks and a trail of orange heat embers.
motion_en: A sudden, explosive forward lunge from a curled position.
lore: 빠른 근접 몹. 절반은 붉게 웅크렸다가 돌진한다. 용암동굴에서는 죽을 때 터지는 개체가 섞인다. 보스 졸개로도 나온다.
